pages.text: A Gem Socket is a bauble that can be worn in the Body slot.$(br2)Activating a Gem Socket allows you to slot in an Arcane Gem. You always treat this gem as if you were holding it for the purposes of passive effects.

The following Arcane Gems have passive effects. Gems with toggles might need to be turned on before inserting before their passive effects take place.$(br2)$(l:gems/slaughtergleam)Slaughtergleam$()$(br)$(l:gems/murdergleam)Murdergleam$()$(br)$(l:gems/agegleam)Agegleam$()$(br)$(l:gems/switchgleam)Switchgleam$()$(br)$(l:gems/salvegleam)Salvegleam$()$(br)$(l:gems/mindspindle)Mindspindle$()$(br)$(l:gems/elixirspindle)Elixirspindle$()$(br)$(l:gems/phoenixway)Phoenixway$()$(br)$(l:gems/stormway)Stormway$()
